title: Chemists and Their Impact on Our Lives

standard_text: Chemists and how they have made an impact on our lives: important chemists and their discoveries, Filipino chemists, models of the atom, and the benefits and risks of chemistry. (summary of the Strengthened Senior High School curriculum, General Science, Term 1)
meta_desc: Free Grade 11 General Science worksheets (Strengthened SHS curriculum, Term 1): famous chemists, Filipino chemists, atomic models, and benefits and risks of chemistry. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: Chemistry is the study of matter and its changes.
key_sub: Each atomic model was built on new evidence.
body_html:
How to think about it

Chemists have changed how we live. Lavoisier showed that mass is conserved; Dalton proposed atoms; Mendeleev organized the periodic table; Marie Curie studied radioactivity; Thomson, Rutherford and Bohr developed models of the atom from new evidence.

Filipino chemists such as National Scientists Julian Banzon and Clara Lim-Sylianco worked on coconut products and on protecting people from harmful chemicals. Chemistry gives us medicines, safe water, fertilizers and materials, but misuse causes pollution, so green chemistry tries to reduce harm.

Example

Who arranged the first periodic table?

Russian chemist

Answer: Dmitri Mendeleev

Example

Which experiment showed the nucleus?

Gold foil

Answer: Rutherford's alpha-particle scattering

Common mistakes

  • Thinking atomic models never change.
  • Thinking chemistry is only done in laboratories.
  • Thinking all chemicals are harmful.

items.q: Which particle in an atom has positive (+) and is in the nucleus?

items.q: Who discovered the neutron?

items.q: What did J. J. Thomson contribute?
c: He described atoms as tiny solid spheres that cannot be divided.
He discovered the electron and proposed the plum pudding model.
He suggested electrons orbit the nucleus at fixed distances (shells).
He showed with the alpha scattering experiment that the atom has a small, dense, positive nucleus.
items.e: Models change with evidence.

items.e: Models change with evidence.
